relationships.subject: netrin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Daily application of recombinant netrin-1 (10 µg/day i.p.) gradually reduced the CCI-induced mechanical hypersensitivity to von Frey filament stimulations and thermal hypersensitivity in the Hargreaves test (Figure 2A,B).

relationships.subject: netrin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Systemic netrin-1 injection effectively rescued Cldn1, Cldn5, and Cldn19 expression and the corresponding proteins (Figure 4A,B,D and Figure 5A,B,D).

relationships.subject: netrin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: The claudin-5 and claudin-19 proteins were completely restored, while claudin-1 increased significantly but not completely.

relationships.subject: netrin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: The CCI-induced Tnfα upregulation was partially, but not completely, suppressed by netrin-1 treatment in the sciatic nerve (Figure 2H).

relationships.subject: neogenin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: local Neo1 suppression by siRNA prevented netrin-1-induced antinociception if netrin-1 was applied systemically.

key_findings: CCI reduces netrin-1 protein and neogenin-1 in rat sciatic nerve; exogenous netrin-1 reverses mechanical and thermal hypersensitivity in a Neo1-dependent manner.
Netrin-1 restores endothelial (claudin-5) and myelin (claudin-19) barrier function but not the perineurial barrier.
